    Design check: accept (new) inside backticks, do not check test-function names; stop messages carry the check reasons
    
    Run 45353435408 (issue #4): the design marked two planned test functions as
    `TestTocHook.test_render_ordered_toc (new)` (marker inside the backticks); the parser only
    accepted the marker after the closing backtick and stripped ')', so a correct design failed
    twice and the run stopped with 'check did not pass within its retries'.
    
    - (new) / [new] accepted inside or after the backticks, any case; trailing () ignored
    - files under tests/ are only checked for existence: test functions are written later by the
      test workers, so the design stage should not be judged on them
    - spec/design/implement failures record their reasons, and the stop message shows them

    Handle test/implementation disagreement instead of looping the implementer
    
    Run 45351202045 (issue #4): the implementation was correct (passes all 4 hidden tests and the
    full suite) but AC-FR-001-2 in the spec expected a flat list where mistune nests sub-lists; the
    worker tested it literally, its own tests failed, and the graph looped implement x2 + redesign
    with no code change until it stopped (~1.7M tokens wasted).
    
    - merge classifies failures: existing tests vs new tests; records which test files fail
    - implement records whether it changed src/ (impl_changed)
    - new route loop_dispute: only new tests fail and the implementer kept its code -> re-send exactly
      those test files to their workers with the failure output (once); workers may report
      AC-CONFLICT lines, shown in test_report.md
    - if they still disagree: stop with 'tests and implementation disagree; a human should decide'
    - stable test file names per requirement group (test_autose_issue_N_fr001.py)

', result)
